title: Apple M4 Max vs M4 Pro: Which Is Better for Local LLMs?
snippet: Sep 25, 2026 · The Apple M4 Max is better than the M4 Pro for local LLMs, primarily on memory bandwidth — up to 546 GB/s versus the M4 Pro's 273 GB/s. Since local LLM inference speed is bandwidth-bound once a model fits in memory, the M4 Max runs every model both chips can fit noticeably faster.
